faq.q: How do I know if I need a full replacement or just a repair?
faq.a: We look at three things: roof age, percentage of surface with damage, and the condition of the deck beneath. A roof over 20 years old with widespread granule loss and multiple leak points almost always needs replacement. A newer roof with isolated damage may only need repair. We will give you an honest assessment at the free inspection.

faq.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in Atlanta?
faq.a: For a typical single-family home in Atlanta, the range is $8,000 to $20,000. The main variables are roof size, pitch, material choice, and deck condition. We do not quote over the phone. The free inspection gives us what we need to provide an exact, written number.

faq.q: Will you work with my insurance company?
faq.a: Yes. We have worked with every major insurer serving the Atlanta market. We document the damage, attend the adjuster meeting if needed, and push back on underpaid scopes. We have handled hundreds of insurance-funded replacements across Atlanta.

faq.q: What does Owens Corning Platinum Preferred mean?
faq.a: It is the top tier of the Owens Corning contractor certification program. It requires documented training, specific insurance coverage levels, and a demonstrated workmanship record. Less than 1% of roofing contractors in the US hold Platinum Preferred status. It means the materials we install carry the full Owens Corning manufacturer warranty.

faq.q: Are you licensed and insured in Georgia?
faq.a: Yes. New Image Roofing Atlanta is licensed in Georgia and carries both general liability and workers' compensation insurance. Ask for our license number and proof of insurance before you hire any contractor.

Every residential roof we install comes with a lifetime labor warranty in writing. If our workmanship fails, we come back and fix it at no charge. Materials are backed by the full Owens Corning manufacturer warranty.

faq.q: How long will the project take?
faq.a: Free inspection the same week you call. Written quote within 24 hours. Scheduling within 1 to 3 weeks depending on weather and crew availability. Installation in 1 to 2 days for a standard residential replacement. Final walkthrough and warranty documentation on the day of completion.

faq.q: How long should a roof last in Atlanta?
faq.a: Standard three-tab shingles last 15 to 20 years. Architectural shingles last 25 to 30 years. Premium impact-resistant shingles can last 30 to 50 years. Atlanta's heat, UV exposure, and storm frequency all accelerate wear. Annual inspection after year 10 is a sensible practice.
